description: Get full technical analysis for a specific coin: signal, Asrix (top and bottom), SuperAsrix (approved top and bottom), PSAR, MACD-DEMA, AlphaTrend (trend indicator), Elliot Wave , TD(trend reversal  tom demark), SMC(Smart money), SR(support and resistance), Ichimoku, RSI divergence (latest bullish / bearish / hidden bullish / hidden bearish with both swing points and candles ago — the same rule as the Asrai chart; a hint that a move is tiring, not a signal by itself). Large raw output (all indicators of one coin, ~10k+ tokens). For a quick verdict, levels, ATR and signal ages use coin_brief instead; use this when you need the full detail (SMC order blocks, Elliott Wave, Ichimoku, every indicator).
